summary: Iteration 3: Full backend + frontend verification of NEW safety-limits + auto-programs features. Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with TestSettings class (GET/PUT/validation/reset) and test_ws_clamp_depth_and_speed (WebSocket server-side clamp). Ran full pytest suite: 27/27 PASSED in 9s. Frontend Playwright tests via public URL: (1) Admin login OK, (2) SAFETY LIMITS card renders with limit-min-depth / limit-max-speed / value displays / save-limits-button, (3) save shows 'Safety limits saved' toast and persists across reload (min=50, max=60), (4) Guest console /c/{CODE} renders AUTO PROGRAMS section with all 6 buttons (wave, buildup, tease, pulse, surge, random), (5) 'min 50' and 'max 60' lock notes shown, (6) DEPTH slider clamped >=50 via keyboard ArrowLeft x80 (stays at 50), (7) SPEED slider clamped <=60 (stays at 60), (8) program-wave click sets start-stop button to STOP, shows program-active-note, and speed changes automatically over time (59->60) while remaining clamped, (9) manual slider touch stops program (takeover), (10) STOP button resets speed=0 & button back to START, (11) clicking the active program again toggles it off. Limits reset to {0,100} at end (verified via GET).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Hub.limits is process-local (single-worker only) — fine for current in-memory Hub design but noted.
Depth clamp only enforces floor (min); no ceiling. Speed clamp only enforces ceiling. This matches spec.
Frontend ControlConsole clampDepth uses max=100 hardcoded — consistent with backend which does not clamp depth upward, OK.

GuestControl.jsx: pre-existing note from iter_1 about ControlConsole remount — verified in this iteration that mounting is stable during phase='active' (component instance retained across state ticks since key doesn't change).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed access codes during backend tests (auto-cleaned via teardown). Left one guest code MAQFTH from UI test (labeled TEST_UI, 5min) — safe to leave, but can be revoked from admin dashboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now has 27 tests including WS clamp verification. Playwright approach: use [data-testid='login-form'] flow with login-email/login-password/login-submit ids, then look for safety-limits-card. For Radix slider clamp testing, focus the [role='slider'] thumb inside slider-{id} and drive with keyboard ArrowLeft/ArrowRight. Limits are broadcast to guest via WS state — must be set BEFORE guest connects.
